notes: In the real gensim codebase (cloned and pip-installed -e from /app/src). The agent must write a generic gensim LDA training pipeline that accepts any corpus directory and serialises a model in gensim's own format. The number of latent topics is not given and differs across corpora, so the agent must discover it by tuning rather than hardcoding; the verifier holds out three unseen corpora of different topic counts and scores c_v coherence plus topic-word purity of the serialised, reloaded model. Naive baselines fail at least one held-out corpus (K=1: coherence collapse on some corpora; fixed K or over-split K=10: purity collapse). Serialisation is asserted by reloading the produced file through gensim.models.LdaModel.load(). Medium bucket via hidden-case generalization and quantitative correctness; single CPU with pinned BLAS threads.
